body: Multilingual large language models (mLLMs) contain a small fraction of feed-forward neurons that are sensitive to particular languages, commonly termed language-specific neurons. Existing work measures language specificity using the entropy of each neuron's language-wise probabilities of being active, where a neuron is considered active when its activation value is positive. However, this approach may not fully capture the multilingual nature of mLLMs, where language representations are distributional and mutually related. We propose Distribution-aware Language Neuron selection, which leverages pairwise relationships between per-language activation distributions over the full activation range, including negative values. Specifically, we quantify each neuron's language specificity by clustering languages using pairwise overlap coefficients between their activation distributions. Across two mLLMs and two held-out corpora, our identifier more effectively isolates language-specific causal effects, yielding up to 4.9× higher on-target language damage per neuron while preserving off-target language performance.
summaryZh: 多语言大模型包含一小部分对特定语言敏感的前馈神经元。现有方法使用激活概率熵来衡量语言特异性，但难以捕捉多语言表征的分布与互相关系。为此，本文提出了分布感知语言神经元选择法，通过全激活范围内的成对重叠系数对语言进行聚类来量化语言特异性。实验表明，该方法能够更有效地隔离语言特异性因果效应，在保持其他语言性能的同时，大幅提高了单位神经元的目标语言损伤度。

glossary.explanationZh: 多语言大语言模型，支持多种自然语言理解与生成的模型
语言特异性神经元，模型中对特定某一种或几种语言高度敏感的神经网络单元
激活分布，神经元在处理不同输入时激活值的统计分布情况
重叠系数，用于衡量两个概率分布或激活分布之间重合程度的统计指标
